header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the petitioners nor any intimation received. This petition was
body: filed in the year 2018 and was lastly fixed in the court on 01.09.2020, but thereafter no efforts were made to proceed with the same.
The perusal of prayer clause reflects that petitioner has filed this petition only for protection against harassment of respondents No.5 to 7.
Learned A.A.G submits that official respondents will act strictly in accordance with the law.
In view of the above, this petition is disposed of with directions to the official respondents to provide protection to the petitioners, as and when required, strictly in accordance with law.
